title: Opening Day
info: Opening evening in the Auditorium and Amphitheatre, with the TANDAV art show by Artist Bhagya Ajaikumar in the Welcome Area.
pts: Inauguration and dance performances by upcoming artists, 4:30 to 6:00 PM
Three Forces, One Stage at 6:30 PM, then Agam Band at 7:30 PM (One ticket includes both shows)
TANDAV art show, open for all

title: Music and Dance
info: Studio spaces run from 10 AM to 4 PM in the Rehearsal Studio, the Banquet Hall and the Amphitheatre. Performances in the Auditorium from 3:30 PM.
pts: A Kathak performance and Khechara Academy of Bharatanatyam (One ticket includes both shows)
Dance Alchemy and Sri Nimishambha School of Dance (One ticket includes both shows)

title: Fusion and Finale
info: Studio spaces run from 7:15 AM to 6 PM. Evening programme from 4:30 PM.
pts: Meipadam, Bharatanatyam and Carving Rhythm linocut workshops
Interactive Discussion on Mahabharata, 4:30 to 6:00 PM
The Warrior's Path, then Mahabharata: A Mirror to Humanity (One ticket includes both shows)
